title: 第1章 师兄的规矩第2章 师姐的问罪
slug: 大罗邪仙苟在剑门当药师
content_zh:
“师姐，真得脱衣服吗？”
“好像真的得脱，这是师兄写在牌子上的规矩。”
万里春江下游的剑门关上，两个女子站在一座药园之前。
她们身着剑门制服，右侧女子成熟丰韵，左侧女子年纪看着还不大，脸上有些许稚气，但腰细胸挺，胸腹间的风情，一如这薄春时节的万里春江。
稚气女子道：“可为什么呀？我给钱还不行吗？听说男的就是给钱的，十块元石一次，我也给钱，我还可以加钱！”
师姐沉吟一会：“要不，试试吧……”
推开园门，面前藤蔓无数。
一条羊肠小道蜿蜒而入药园深处，转过前面如屏风一般的藤蔓，一棵古老的合欢树下，有一张茶几。
茶几之上，有一只脚。
一个男人斜躺在躺椅上，手中端着一只竹杯，惬意地品着茶。
这个男人看着也就二十来岁，长相还算人畜无害，但是，他额头一道长长的血色伤疤，让他懒散中带了几分痞气。
“度凌师兄！”丰韵女子鞠躬道：“我师妹想来悟道。”
那个年轻男子，度凌师兄眼皮略略一抬，懒洋洋地指一指旁边。
旁边一块木牌，钉在合欢树上。
上面写着一行大字：“悟道，男子十块元石一次，女子脱衣洗澡一次。”
“师兄！”丰韵女子道：“师妹情况有些特殊，在这里洗澡有些不妥，能不能……”
话未说完，度凌右手一垂，从躺椅旁边又拿起了一块小牌子，上面写着八个小字：“莫要多言，配合就好。”
那个稚气未脱的师妹开口了：“我加钱！我加钱还不行吗？”
丰韵师姐帮腔：“是啊，度凌师兄，谁还没个难处呢？通融下，都是剑门一脉，不看僧面看佛面，何必呢？”
度凌仰面朝天，轻轻一叹，终于开口了：“居于剑门一隅，说同是剑门一脉，貌似也没什么大毛病！行吧，我通融下，免得你们说我油盐不进，不近人情……”

两个女子大喜。
度凌道：“你们给我二十三枚元石，我成全她一次，丑话说在前面，仅限这一次，出门概不作数，且下不为例。”
“好！”稚气女子开心了。
手一抬，腰间的兽皮钱袋在手，打开……一、二、三……二十二块！
“师姐，借一块元石！”稚气女手伸向旁边的师姐。
师姐身上一顿乱摸：“我今天出门急，忘带元石了。”
稚气女尴尬了，目光投向度凌：“师兄，就差一块元石……”
度凌轻轻摇头：“那就没办法了。”
“缺的那一块，我等会儿送过来。”稚气女道。
“不行！”
“我送十块……不，三十块！”
“刚才已经说过，通融是有条件的，仅限这一次，出门概不作数。”
“你……你……”稚气女脸涨得通红：“……哪里洗澡？”
洗澡的地方，在后面的药池。
稚气女一进后面的那个藤蔓隔开的药池边，就解开了腰带，三两下扒得精光，一头扎入药池。
度凌师兄笑了，笑得额头的那道血痕都起了波浪，他的手轻轻一分，身后的藤蔓开了一道窗户，从这个角度看过去，可以看到药池水面，水面的涟漪还没有散尽，但也看不到那个稚气女，因为药水是碧绿的，除了药池之中的一棵青莲，其他的，什么也看不着。
“师兄，我劝过你了。”旁边那个师姐轻轻叹口气。
“什么？”
“师妹情况特殊。”
“看着也没什么特殊的啊？除了一点，身材比同龄人更丰满些。”度凌漫不经心地重新托起了茶杯。
content_en:
"Sister, do you really need to take off your clothes?"
"It seems like you really have to take it off. This is the rule written on the sign by senior brother."
The sword gate on the lower reaches of Wanli Chunjiang River was closed, and two women stood in front of a medicine garden.
They were wearing Jianmen uniforms. The woman on the right was mature and graceful, while the woman on the left looked still young, with a slightly childish face, but her waist was thin and her chest was straight. The amorous feelings between her chest and abdomen were just like the spring river in this thin spring season.
The childish woman said: "But why? Isn't it okay if I give you money? I heard that men give you money, ten yuan stones a time. I also give you money, and I can add more!"
The senior sister pondered for a while: "How about giving it a try..."
Pushing open the garden gate, there are countless vines in front of you.
A winding path winds into the depths of the medicine garden, turning around the screen-like vines in front, and there is a coffee table under an ancient albizia tree.
There is a foot on the coffee table.
A man was lying on a recliner, holding a bamboo cup in his hand, sipping tea comfortably.
This man looked to be in his twenties, and he looked relatively harmless. However, a long bloody scar on his forehead gave him a lazy and ruffian air.
"Senior Brother Du Ling!" Fengyun woman bowed and said, "My junior sister wants to come to enlightenment."
That young man, Senior Brother Du Ling raised his eyelids slightly and pointed lazily to the side.
Next to it is a wooden sign, nailed to the acacia tree.
There is a line of big characters written on it: "Enlightenment, men will receive ten yuan stones once, and women will take off their clothes and take a bath once."
"Senior brother!" Fengyun woman said: "Junior sister's situation is a bit special. It's not appropriate to take a bath here. Can you..."
Before he finished speaking, Du Ling lowered his right hand and picked up a small sign from beside the recliner with eight small characters written on it: "Don't say too much, just cooperate."
The childish junior sister spoke up: "I'll give you more money! Isn't it okay if I give you more money?"
Senior Sister Fengyun helped: "That's right, Senior Brother Du Ling, who doesn't have a problem? Under the accommodating circumstances, they are all from the Sword Sect. If you don't look at the monk's face and the Buddha's face, why bother?"
Du Ling looked up to the sky, sighed softly, and finally spoke: "Living in a corner of Jianmen, saying that we are from the same lineage of Jianmen, there seems to be nothing wrong with it! Okay, I will be accommodating, so that you don't say that I am indifferent and unreasonable..."
The two women were overjoyed.
Du Ling said: "You give me twenty-three Yuan Stones, and I will help her once. The ugly words will come from the front. It is only for this time. It will not count when I go out, and it will not be the same next time."
"Okay!" The childish woman was happy.
He raised his hand and took the animal skin money bag around his waist. He opened it...one, two, three...twenty-two yuan!
"Senior sister, lend me a piece of Yuan Stone!" The childish girl stretched out her hand to the senior sister next to her.
The senior sister fumbled around and said, "I was in a hurry today and forgot to bring the Yuan Stone with me."
The childish girl was embarrassed and turned to Du Ling: "Senior brother, all we need is one yuan stone..."
Du Ling shook his head gently: "Then there is nothing we can do."
"I'll deliver the missing piece later." The childish woman said.
"No!"
"I'll give you ten yuan... no, thirty yuan!"
"As I said just now, accommodation is conditional. It is only for this time. Going out will not count."
"You...you..." the childish girl's face turned red: "...where can I take a bath?"
The bathing place is in the medicine pool at the back.
As soon as the childlike girl entered the medicine pool separated by vines at the back, she untied her belt, stripped her naked in two or two strokes, and plunged into the medicine pool.
Senior Brother Du Ling smiled, so much that the blood mark on his forehead rippled. He moved his hand slightly, and the vines behind him opened a window. Looking from this angle, you can see the water of the medicine pond. The ripples on the water have not dispersed yet, but you can't see the childish girl because the potion is green. Except for a green lotus in the medicine pond, nothing else can be seen.
"Senior brother, I have advised you." The senior sister next to him sighed softly.
"What?"
"Junior sister is in a special situation."
"It doesn't look like anything special.Special? Except for one thing, her figure is plumper than her peers. "Du Ling picked up the tea cup again casually.
